summary: Frontend testing of Chutex Care homepage v3 redesign inspired by kora.framer.media. All 16 features tested and passed. Hero displays full-screen background image with dark gradient overlay, title with blue gradient 'prevention' highlight, CTA buttons, trusted by families section, and partner logos. Header uses floating pill design with dark glass effect (bg-slate-900/80) that persists on scroll keeping white text visible. Desktop has nav pill left + separate glass buttons right (flag/currency, search, user, cart). Mobile has glass circle hamburger left, white logo centered, glass circle cart right. New sections: ScrollText with word-by-word opacity reveal animation, BeforeAfter comparison cards (beige 'without' vs dark 'with'), Products with numbered services (01 Elder, 02 Elio, 03 Vita) with alternating layouts and embedded testimonials, HowItWorks with 4 phase cards, Stats with dark background and counter animations, App section, Testimonials, CTA section, and Footer.

integration_issues.issue: CORS error when calling ipapi.co/json/ for language/currency auto-detection. Site falls back to browser language detection which works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Header floating pill design with dark glass (bg-slate-900/80) persists on scroll - white text remains visible
Mobile header correctly implements glass circle buttons for hamburger and cart with centered white logo
Products section uses numbered services style (01, 02, 03) with alternating image/text layouts
Each product card includes embedded testimonial quote with author name
Stats section has counter animations on dark background (slate-950)
ScrollText section implements word-by-word opacity reveal using framer-motion useScroll/useTransform
BeforeAfter comparison uses beige (#F5F0E8) for 'without' and dark (slate-900) for 'with' cards
HowItWorks shows 4 phase cards with icons (Package, Smartphone, Link2, ShieldCheck)
Language switcher with country flags from flagcdn.com works correctly for FR/EN
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
